description.value: Parkgate Farm Market is a neighbourhood grocery store located within Parkgate Village shopping centre in the Mount Seymour district of North Vancouver. The market focuses on fresh local fruits and vegetables for everyday grocery needs. It sits within a larger strip mall complex anchored by a Safeway and surrounded by a broad range of services including a pharmacy, medical centre, and butcher.
